title: User model and repository
goal: All user reads and writes go through one repository and service, with normalised email, validated profile fields and soft-deletion states.
scope_in: Kysely repository `UserRepo` over the B008 users table: create, findById, findByEmail (case-insensitive), updateProfile, markDeletionRequested, markDeleted, listByIds.
Domain service `UserService` applying CT-IDS text rules: email lower-cased, <=254 chars, NFC; display name 1-40 chars without control chars; locale a valid BCP 47 tag, default `en`.
Creation of a user's personal one-person workspace + owner membership in the same transaction on first sign-in (`getOrCreateByEmail`).
Default display name derived from the email local part (truncated to 40) when the login method provides none.
Typed errors (CT-ERR) for invalid profile fields.
scope_out: Login methods (magic link B014, social B015), tokens (B017).
HTTP endpoints for the user (B022) and account deletion/export jobs (B026).
Workspace management beyond the personal workspace bootstrap (B027).
build_against: B010 test stack (real Postgres) with the B008 schema; errors from B006.
interfaces: `interface UserRepo { create(u: NewUser): Promise<User>; findById(id: string): Promise<User|null>; findByEmail(email: string): Promise<User|null>; updateProfile(id: string, patch: ProfilePatch): Promise<User>; markDeletionRequested(id: string, at: Date): Promise<void>; }`.

`class UserService { constructor(deps:{repo: UserRepo; db: Kysely<Database>; newId: typeof newId; now: () => Date}); getOrCreateByEmail(email: string, hints?:{name?: string}): Promise<{user: User; created: boolean}>; updateProfile(id: string, patch: ProfilePatch): Promise<User>; }`.
`type ProfilePatch = { display_name?: string; locale?: string; avatar_slot?: number; telemetry_opt_in?: boolean }`.
acceptance: `getOrCreateByEmail('A@Example.COM')` and later `('a@example.com')` return the same user; the second call has `created:false`.
50 concurrent first sign-ins for one email create exactly one user and one personal workspace.
First creation inserts a workspace (name = display name, 1-60 chars) and an `owner` membership atomically; a failure in either rolls back both.
`updateProfile({display_name:''})` and a 41-char name fail with a validation `AppError` pointing to `/display_name`; a name containing U+0000 fails; an NFD name is stored NFC.
Locale `en-GB` is accepted, `english` rejected; an unset locale is `en`.
Users with status `pending_deletion` or `deleted` are returned by findById with their status; findByEmail returns them too (callers decide).
The repo never returns more columns than the User type (no raw row leakage).
tests: user-repo.test.ts: CRUD against real Postgres, email case-insensitivity.
user-service.test.ts: normalisation and 50-way concurrent first sign-in.
validation.test.ts: table-driven display-name, locale, email edge cases.
guardrails: MUST lower-case and NFC-normalise email before every lookup and write; MUST NOT compare emails case-sensitively anywhere.
MUST NOT log email addresses; log `usr_` ids only.
MUST NOT expose another user's email to unrelated callers (authorisation is B021's job; this service returns the full User only to server code).
MUST create user and personal workspace in one transaction.
failure_modes: Unique-violation race -> re-read and return the existing user.
Invalid email shape -> validation AppError (no DB call).
DB unavailable -> typed unavailable error, no partial user.
notes: Email release semantics for deleted accounts are not specified by the contracts; B026 decides. CONTRACT GAP: avatar_slot range is not defined in CT-API-ACCOUNTS; accept integer 0..255 and tighten when the contract says. markDeleted is declared here but used by B026.
